title: Ancient 'as above, so below' symbol on property

tellings.quote: As above, so below as the Masonic symbol on the property from ancient times seems to denote.

plain: An old symbol on Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property long tied to reports of strange events, stands for the saying "as above, so below," according to the ranch's owner. He tells Michels this "Masonic symbol on the property from ancient times seems to denote" that what happens in the sky is matched by something below the ground, which fits his view that something lies under the ranch.
